scope: Public generic operations whose IDs begin zone., business., events., or legacy.; documented interfaces and source call routing only; no reference outcomes are recorded.

shared_domains.zone: A canonical zone name or recognized alias; resolution is case-insensitive in the TZ receiver.
shared_domains.offset: One of +HH, +HHMM, +HHMMSS, +HH:MM, +HH:MM:SS, or a signed [hour, minute, second] array.
shared_domains.civil_value: A six-field civil date/time array or one of the documented canonical date strings, as accepted by the individual method.
shared_domains.period: Twelve elements: UTC/local starts, text and array offset, abbreviation, DST flag, UTC/local ends, and four canonical timestamp strings. Positive indexes only are stable.
holiday_grammar: yearless date that accepts an appended year

gaps: No operation has a reviewed literal reference observation, so every listed partition is unobserved.
Zone/alias/abbreviation/period enumerations are generated tzdata content. A future probe fixture must pin the bundled tzdata/tzcode versions and name a finite selection; no dataset is copied here.
Holiday and event grammar is enumerated only at documented production level. Date, recurrence, and delta subgrammars are owned by their corresponding contract families.
Business configuration (work week/hours, TomorrowFirst, holiday/event loading) requires an isolated named profile before behavior can be promoted.
DM5/DM6 exact wrapper parity, scalar/list-context details, diagnostics, error strings, and legacy state effects remain probe obligations.
